Why put my hotel online?

Since MCO, guests plan, book and travel differently. Here is what has changed, and why being easy to find online matters for your property.

Travel & booking

Guests now search, compare and book on their phones, reading reviews and checking prices before they choose where to stay.

Socialising

Reunions, celebrations and catch-ups with family and friends now happen on short stays away from home, at places that look good online.

Food culture

Food is part of the trip. Guests look for local flavours and good cafes nearby, and often decide where to stay based on it.

Getting away

Short, frequent breaks are replacing the one long holiday a year, so guests book more often and at shorter notice.

Huge demand in hospitality, post-MCO

Leisure

Celebrations, family holidays and personal getaways.

Experiences

Late nights out, long drives and adventure tours.

Business

Corporate functions, intercity short stays and job requirements.

Better for guests. Better for partners.
